title: Herbert Wolverson - Procedural Map Generation Techniques
summary: Herbert Wolverson's Roguelike Celebration 2020 talk surveying procedural map generation techniques, including integration of hand-crafted prefabs and vaults.
why: HN recommends it as a fun, informative survey of easy-to-implement dungeon generation methods from the author of the Rust roguelike tutorial.

quote.text: My favorite from that collection on map generation is by Herbert Wolverson
